title: dxn expectations
description: Editor aid for expectations.json: rules the model must follow. Each expectation selects contexts of a node (optionally its subtree, in one root, filtered with when) and makes exactly one assertion: then (every selected context has these values), some (at least one does) or exists (the node is there, or not, wherever when holds). A transition rule adds on: when the node is in a state, on an event, then it is in another state and focus is on a node. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that nodes and roots exist, that names and values belong to the node, that an expectation selects some contexts, and that it holds, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

title.description: What the expectation says, shown when it fails.

node.description: The node whose contexts are counted.

subtree.description: Count the contexts of every node in the node's subtree.

root.description: Count only in this root; without it, in every root that contains the node.

when.description: Dimension, state group, shared node or profile -> the value to keep.

then.description: Every selected context has these values.

some.description: At least one selected context has all these values.

exists.description: Whether the node is there in every combination where when holds (true) or in none (false).

on.description: For a transition rule: the event, with the fields it uses (key, target, outside, or for a resize the dimension values it reaches). Goes only with then, which names the shared node's state after and where focus ends up.

values.description: Dimension, state group, shared node or profile -> one value, or a list of allowed values; attributes -> attribute -> value or values, checked for every state in each context.
